in_text_mentions: Diagnostic cystoscopy with retrograde pyelography and micturating cystourethrography (Figure 2A-2B) revealed a low-volume bladder (approximately 40 mL) with an incompetent bladder neck. The right ureteric orifice could not be visualised, and the left ureteric orifice lay at the edge of the meatus. Retrograde pyelography (Figure 2C) revealed a grossly dilated tortuous left ectopic ureter.
